summary: Tested KPI/PPM theming and PPM send-reminders endpoint. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Pulse Pro has data-portal='pulse' attribute enabling light mode CSS overrides. KPI and PPM components use themed CSS classes with [data-portal='pulse'] selectors for white backgrounds and dark text.

backend_ppm_send_reminders.details: POST /api/ppm/send-reminders returns {sent: 0, checked: N} - correctly checks tasks within 1/2/3 month windows. Returns sent=0 because existing tasks are scheduled beyond 95 days.

backend_kpi_dashboard_7_kpis.details: GET /api/reports/kpi-dashboard returns all 7 KPIs: ppm_compliance, equipment_downtime, reactive_response, safety_critical, safety_compliance, oos_ratio, commissioning

backend_kpi_structure.details: All KPI structures verified: PPM compliance has total_scheduled/completed/compliance_pct, equipment_downtime has worst_performing_assets array, safety_critical has sla_breaches

backend_ppm_schedules.details: GET /api/ppm/schedules and GET /api/ppm/summary both return correct data

backend_auth.details: Both Master Admin (admin@gymaxisai.com) and Pulse Pro (lee.somers@pulsefitness.com) can login successfully

frontend_pulse_pro_theming.details: LiteDashboardPage has data-portal='pulse' attribute. KPI and PPM components detected with .kpi-themed and .ppm-themed classes.

frontend_kpi_dashboard_pulse.details: KPI Performance Dashboard found with 8 KPI cards, Worst Performing Machines section visible. Cards have white backgrounds with dark text per CSS overrides.

frontend_ppm_subtab_pulse.details: PPM SubTab found with summary cards (Active Schedules, Upcoming 90d, Completed, Overdue, Compliance). New Schedule button visible.

frontend_css_theming_approach.details: CSS uses dark-first approach with [data-portal='pulse'] overrides. KPI: .kpi-card bg #121212 (dark) -> #FFFFFF (pulse). PPM: .ppm-card bg #121212 (dark) -> #FFFFFF (pulse). Text colors properly inverted.

critical_code_review_comments: Theming implementation follows established IssueDetailPanel pattern with [data-portal='pulse'] CSS selectors
PPM send-reminders correctly checks 25-35 days (1 month), 55-65 days (2 months), 85-95 days (3 months) windows
Reminder deduplication via reminder_Xm_sent flags prevents duplicate emails
KPI dashboard shows all 7 gym-focused KPIs with proper accessibility (bold text, high contrast colors)
